name: 97383 · Stayton, OR
findings: ZIP 97383 (Stayton) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97383 (Stayton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97383 (Stayton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97383 (Stayton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
